title: chore(testing): don't check the commit messages
body:
We squash PRs anyway, we could test PR titles instead but it's not really needed IMO

It's super annoying to make commits on GitHub otherwise

comments.body:

Built with commit 690f0f4b499d008841d4100a5d5bb7d393487ff4

Thanks for this contribution but it's important that our messages are correctly formatted. It is a cornerstone for automatically building our changelog which is otherwise a pain to write accurately.
I think we should check for PR titles then, not for commit messages (because we _only_ squash)

That's an interesting idea. Let's discuss that as par of the bi-weekly core sync. Thanks for proposing this PR. I will close it for now.
